survey: A single brown leather cowboy boot in side view, toe to the right, floating on a radial orange background. The tall shaft is stitched to the foot with a seam at the ankle, and its scalloped top is open, showing the tan lining. The foot narrows to a pointed toe. A dark brown outsole runs from toe to heel, with a slanted stacked heel block under the rear. A gold spur sits at the back of the heel. Its heel band curves forward along the outer side of the foot at ankle height and stops in a rounded tip about halfway along the foot. A short shank sticks out backward and holds a spiked rowel on an axle. The band does not continue into a strap over the instep, and there is no buckle or strap button. The rest of the boot is built correctly: the shaft, foot, sole and heel all join where they should.

errors.where: Gold spur, side of the foot above the heel
errors.what: The spur's heel band stops in a blunt tip on the side of the foot. There is no spur strap over the instep, no strap button and no buckle, so nothing holds the spur on the boot. It reads as a bracket stuck onto the leather rather than a spur strapped around the heel.

fix: Make the gold spur's heel band wrap around the back of the heel and end at a small button on each side, just below the ankle. Fasten a thin leather spur strap with a small gold buckle to the buttons and run it across the instep, over the top of the foot, so the spur is clearly strapped onto the boot.
